description: HydroRIVERS represents vectorized line network of all global rivers with catchment >=10km2 or flow >=0.1 m3/sec. 8.5 million reaches avg 4.2km, 35.9 million km total.
license: Free for scientific, educational, commercial, CC BY 4.0-like (see HydroSHEDS Technical Documentation)
reference: Lehner, B., Grill G. (2013). Global river hydrography and network routing. Hydrological Processes, 27(15): 2171-2186. https://doi.org/10.1002/hyp.9740
risk_logic: Heavy rainfall + River proximity (500m buffer) + Elevation -> Flood risk -> Affected settlements/roads/infrastructure
